The Trump administration has moved to close a loophole allowing Chinese companies to access advanced Nvidia AI chips through overseas data centers. 
The new restrictions target chip exports to high-risk countries, including Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia and Thailand, and will take effect in 90 days.
Source: WaPo
